results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_group_submap_ready
results.evidence: Register-passed object index (EAX) is used to index the tag-data array at DAT_0087bc14 (stride 0x20, +0x14 pointer) to fetch a bitmap-group block; validates param_2 modulo the group's submap count and, if a matching submap struct exists, calls FUN_00444550 (device/cache state check) then conditionally FUN_00518680 (the same apply helper used by the rasterizer_set_texture family) before returning.
results.summary: Validates that a bitmap-group submap index is available for the object referenced in EAX and triggers a texture reapply via FUN_00518680 when needed.

results.name: rasterizer_set_texture_variant_a
results.evidence: Structurally identical validate/compare/apply logic to rasterizer_set_texture (same DAT_0071d164+0xb8 table lookup, FUN_0043f250 current-shader comparison, FUN_00518680 apply call) but reads its stage index from an implicit CX register instead of an explicit stack argument, and caches the resolved bitmap width/height into DAT_006d9870/DAT_006d9872 instead of DAT_006d986c/DAT_006d986e.
results.summary: Resolves and caches the active bitmap submap for a texture stage passed in CX, storing its width/height for later use.

results.name: rasterizer_set_texture
results.evidence: Given three explicit args (object/context, stage, bitmap index): validates the stage/bitmap combination against the current bound shader (FUN_0043f250) or the object's own shader block via the DAT_0087bc14 tag-data lookup, then calls FUN_00518680 to bind the resolved bitmap and caches its width/height into DAT_006d986c/DAT_006d986e; called from 14 sites, the most general of this function family (see rasterizer_set_texture_variant_a/b).
results.summary: Resolves and binds the bitmap submap for a given texture stage/index, caching its resolved width and height for reuse.

results.name: rasterizer_set_texture_variant_b
results.evidence: Same validate/compare/apply skeleton as rasterizer_set_texture and rasterizer_set_texture_variant_a, but additionally gates the fallback path on FUN_00444550 (device/cache readiness check) and caches the resolved bitmap dimensions into DAT_006d9874/DAT_006d9876; stage index again arrives via an implicit register (unaff_DI) rather than a stack argument.
results.summary: Variant of the texture-stage resolve/cache routine that also checks device readiness via FUN_00444550 before applying the bitmap and caching its dimensions.

results.name: rasterizer_set_model_skinning
results.evidence: Iterates a node-weight array (unaff_EDI, stride 0x34) whose count is min(DAT_0069c67e, node-list count), for each node scaling a 4x3-style matrix by the node weight into the global palette buffer starting at &DAT_007c04e8 (12 floats per node); when param_1 is nonzero, uploads the resulting palette as vertex shader constants (register 0x1d, 3 floats per node) via vtable+0x178 — the classic Blam vertex-blending/skinning matrix-palette build.
results.summary: Builds the weighted skinning matrix palette for a model's blended nodes and optionally uploads it as vertex shader constants.

results.name: rasterizer_fog_plane_copy_to_slot
results.evidence: When in_EAX (a fog-plane index) is -1, zeroes a 0x30-byte record at in_CX*0x30+in_EDX; otherwise copies plane position/basis fields from the global fog-plane tables (&DAT_007c1488/8c/90 etc, stride 0x38) into that slot and computes an inverse squared-radius term (puVar3[3]) and a near/far reciprocal falloff, matching the per-object fog-plane cache consumed by render_objects_transparent.
results.summary: Copies (or clears) a cached fog-plane record — position, inverse radius squared, and near/far falloff — into slot in_CX of the buffer at in_EDX.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_object_render
results.evidence: Prepares up to two fog-plane cache slots via FUN_00518c10, packs an object's basis/position (param_1 floats) into a compact local buffer, and uploads it as vertex shader constants (register 0xf, 11 floats, via vtable+0x178); when the object has more than two attached nodes it instead defers to render_objects_transparent to walk the remainder.
results.summary: Prepares per-object fog-plane and transform-basis vertex shader constants for a transparent object, deferring to render_objects_transparent when more nodes remain.

results.name: render_objects_transparent
results.evidence: Iterates a chain of transparent-object nodes (unaff_EBX) two at a time via FUN_00518c10, uploading fog-plane/basis constants at register 0xf as in rasterizer_transparent_object_render, and tail-recurses into itself while unaff_SI (processed count) is below the chain length (unaff_EBX+0x10) — a direct continuation of that function for objects with more than two nodes.
results.summary: Iterates a chain of transparent-object nodes two at a time, uploading fog-plane and transform constants and recursing until every node has been processed.

results.name: rasterizer_set_frustum_planes
results.evidence: Transforms the frustum clip-plane rows at &DAT_007c1294 into local space via the object matrix at &DAT_007c13d0, then (on legacy drivers, DAT_007c118c<0xffff0101) uploads the transformed rows plus fog-plane constants (DAT_007c1228..123c) as fixed-function clip planes (vtable+0xb0) and pixel/vertex shader constants (vtable+0x178) at registers matching fog/plane usage elsewhere in the module.
results.summary: Transforms the current view frustum's clip planes into the object's local space and uploads them, together with fog-plane parameters, as shader/clip-plane constants.

results.name: rasterizer_set_shader_stage_config
results.evidence: Switches on a mode value (in_AX, cached against DAT_0069c6ac to skip redundant work) and issues a fixed sequence of SetRenderState-style calls (vtable+0xe4) selecting different texture-stage-count/blend-depth combinations for modes 0-5, finishing by writing the resulting stage count to render states 0x3a/0x3b — called throughout the module whenever the active shading configuration changes.
results.summary: Applies a cached, mode-dependent bundle of render states that switches the fixed-function pipeline between the module's shading configurations.

results.name: rasterizer_apply_transparent_decal_zbias
results.evidence: If bit 0x4000000 of the render-flags word DAT_007c10e4 is set, writes render state 0xc3 from DAT_00722b80; if bit 0x2000000 is set, writes render state 0xaf from DAT_00722b88 — a depth-bias pair applied for transparent decals, mirrored by chimera__transparent_decal_zbias with a different bias source and by rasterizer_clear_decal_zbias which resets both to zero.
results.summary: Applies the decal-pass depth-bias render states (0xc3, 0xaf) from a bias table when the corresponding decal-bias flags are set.

results.name: rasterizer_set_transparent_decal_zbias
results.evidence: Identical gating and render-state targets (0xc3/0xaf) to rasterizer_apply_transparent_decal_zbias but reads its bias values from a different pair of globals (DAT_00722b84/DAT_00722b8c) — part of the same decal z-bias family, alongside rasterizer_clear_decal_zbias which zeroes the bias.
results.summary: Applies decal-pass depth-bias render states (0xc3/0xaf) from an alternate bias table, mirroring rasterizer_apply_transparent_decal_zbias for a different bias set.

results.name: rasterizer_clear_decal_zbias
results.evidence: Same gated pattern (bits 0x4000000/0x2000000 of DAT_007c10e4) as the two decal z-bias setters above, but always writes 0 to render states 0xc3 and 0xaf, resetting the depth bias to neutral.
results.summary: Resets the decal depth-bias render states (0xc3, 0xaf) back to zero when the corresponding bias flags are active.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_zbias_active
results.evidence: Returns nonzero exactly when either decal depth-bias flag (bits 0x4000000 or 0x2000000 of DAT_007c10e4) is set — the boolean predicate matching the mask tested by rasterizer_apply_transparent_decal_zbias / rasterizer_set_transparent_decal_zbias / rasterizer_clear_decal_zbias.
results.summary: Returns whether either decal depth-bias flag is currently set in the render-flags word.

results.name: rasterizer_round_up_resolution_height
results.evidence: A ladder of literal comparisons/returns against 0x1e0,0x240,600,0x2d0,0x300,0x360,900,0x3c0,0x400,0x41a,0x438,0x4b0,0x5a0,0x640,0x870 — exactly the common vertical display resolutions (480,576,600,720,768,864,900,960,1024,1050,1080,1200,1440,1600,2160) — rounding an input height up to the nearest supported one.
results.summary: Rounds an input vertical screen resolution up to the nearest value in a table of common display heights.

results.name: rasterizer_editbox_log_dump
results.evidence: References strings "editbox.ksml" and "log.ksml"; builds a wide-string path of the form "<n>/editbox.ksml" and "<n>/log.ksml" (n from rasterizer_round_up_resolution_height) and loads them into the debug UI engine handle DAT_00721ea4 via its LoadDocument-style vtable call (DAT_00721eb4), first releasing any previously loaded editbox document (DAT_00721eb8/ec8).
results.summary: Loads the editbox and log KSML UI-layout files, from a resolution-specific subfolder, into the debug UI engine.

results.name: rasterizer_ksml_ui_shutdown
results.evidence: Releases the editbox/log KSML documents tracked in PTR_PTR_0069c698/0069c69c (via DAT_00721eb8 lookup + double DAT_00721ec8 Release) and destroys the KSML engine instance (DAT_00721eac), zeroing DAT_00721ea4 — the shutdown counterpart of rasterizer_editbox_log_dump.
results.summary: Tears down the debug KSML UI engine, releasing the editbox and log documents and destroying the engine instance.

results.name: rasterizer_resource_file_verify_signature
results.evidence: Rejects buffers shorter than 0x22 bytes; otherwise calls FUN_00618350/FUN_0061a730 (unnamed helpers) to derive a 33-byte reference into local_24 and compares it byte-for-byte against the tail of the loaded buffer (unaff_EBX+in_EAX-0x21); invoked from rasterizer_load_file_and_verify immediately after a raw file read to accept/reject the loaded data.
results.summary: Validates a loaded resource buffer by comparing its trailing signature bytes against a computed reference value, rejecting undersized buffers.

results.name: rasterizer_load_file_and_verify
results.evidence: Standard CreateFileA/GetFileSize/GlobalAlloc/ReadFile/CloseHandle sequence reading an entire file (named via the ECX register) into a newly allocated buffer, then calls rasterizer_resource_file_verify_signature on the result and frees the buffer via GlobalFree if verification fails, otherwise returning the buffer and size through the two output parameters.
results.summary: Reads an entire file into a newly allocated buffer, verifies it with rasterizer_resource_file_verify_signature, and returns the buffer and size on success.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_decals_enabled
results.evidence: Returns true only when the decal/frustum mode flag (short)DAT_007c1220==1 and the feature-enable flag DAT_00689421 are both set, and either of the DirectX9-capability flags DAT_0069c688/DAT_0069c68a is set or the driver version DAT_007c118c exceeds 0xffff0100; the exact same compound condition is repeated verbatim as the entry guard of rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_render_state_initialize and rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw.
results.summary: Returns whether the current mode and driver capabilities allow transparent-decal/shader-based geometry-group rendering to proceed.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_render_state_initialize
results.evidence: Guarded by the same capability check used by rasterizer_transparent_decals_enabled plus a not-yet-initialized flag (DAT_0071d1b1); on first run it sets a large fixed battery of render/texture-stage states, uploads vertex shader constants for a screen-space quad, installs a vertex declaration (vtable+0x14c) for decal/transparent-geometry-group rendering, then calls FUN_0052ccc0 and rasterizer_set_shader_stage_config before marking the state DAT_0071d1b2 as initialized.
results.summary: Performs one-time setup of the render states, shader constants and vertex declaration used by the transparent-geometry-group (decal) drawing path.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw
results.evidence: Gated by rasterizer_transparent_decals_enabled; conditionally calls chimera__rasterizer_set_frustum_z_func (rasterizer_set_frustum_planes) for negative-flagged groups, binds the group's texture via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture_direct_d3d9, uploads per-group transform/plane vertex-shader constants built from param_1's fields, calls chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices(0) to issue the draw, then when the group's blend factor (unaff_EBX) is below 1.0 performs an additional distortion/refraction pass via FUN_00526f50/FUN_0052b050/FUN_0052b530/FUN_00511ef0.
results.summary: Draws one transparent-geometry (decal) group: configures the frustum/texture/shader state, issues its vertex draw call, and optionally applies a distortion pass based on the group's blend factor.

results.name: rasterizer_decals_initialize
results.evidence: String "decal vertex cache" plus calls to cache_new(...) creating a 0xa00-entry, 0x800-byte-stride cache and crc32_update for its lock buffer, exactly matching an existing confirmed non-FUN_ name from a prior session (cea-pdb hint).
results.summary: Creates the Direct3D vertex buffer and lock-cache used to store dynamically generated decal vertices.

results.name: rasterizer_decals_vertex_buffer_lock
results.evidence: Sets state flag DAT_0069c632 to 5 (locking) then calls the Direct3D vertex buffer Lock method (vtable+0x2c) on DAT_0071d1bc — the vertex buffer/lock handle created by rasterizer_decals_initialize — restoring the flag to 4 afterward.
results.summary: Locks the decal dynamic vertex buffer (created by rasterizer_decals_initialize) for writing, via its Direct3D Lock vtable method.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_pass_begin
results.evidence: Sets a battery of fixed-function texture-stage and render states (lighting/alpha-test/fill-mode/shade-mode/clip-plane via vtable+0x114/0xe4) characteristic of beginning a decal render pass, applies the object's cached decal bitmap via rasterizer_set_texture_variant_a's underlying pattern (FUN_00518680), and dispatches extra mode-specific state through rasterizer_set_shader_stage_config when the stage equals 3; paired functionally with rasterizer_decal_pass_end.
results.summary: Prepares fixed-function render states and texture bindings for beginning a decal rendering pass on the given stage.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_layer_draw
results.evidence: Walks a linked list of decal instances from a hash table (DAT_006b0ad8) indexed by screen-cell/stage, switching texture-stage blend states per decal type (0-7, matching the identical switch table reused in rasterizer_dispose_call_from_rasterizer and the duplicated fragment at 0x51ad91), sets per-decal tint/alpha constants derived from packed color, and issues a draw for each.
results.summary: Walks the decal hash-bucket for the given screen cell, configuring blend-mode texture-stage states per decal type and drawing each decal quad with its tinted color/alpha.

results.name: rasterizer_dispose_call_from_rasterizer
results.evidence: Declared size is only 7 bytes (likely a small vtable/dispose trampoline) while Ghidra's decompiled body pulls in the same decal blend-state switch/draw loop seen in rasterizer_decal_layer_draw and the zero-caller fragment at 0x51ad91; the visible code does not itself justify a 'dispose' semantic, so the kept name (already present, non-FUN_) is retained with low confidence pending confirmation that the true 7-byte body is a small forwarding stub registered as a dispose callback.
results.summary: A small (7-byte) rasterizer entry point, most likely a dispose/cleanup trampoline; the large decompiled body shown is shared decal blend-state code pulled in from an adjacent function layout rather than this function's own logic.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_type_blend_state_apply_and_draw
results.evidence: Zero callers, and its body duplicates verbatim the per-decal-type blend/texture-stage switch and draw loop found in rasterizer_decal_layer_draw and rasterizer_dispose_call_from_rasterizer, indicating this Ghidra function (switchD_0051ab84::caseD_0) is a synthesized fallthrough fragment of the decal-layer switch rather than an independently called routine.
results.summary: Applies per-decal-type blend and texture-stage render states and issues the decal draw; a duplicated fragment of the decal-layer draw switch with no direct callers.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_pass_end
results.evidence: Resets render state 0x1c (clip-plane enable) to 0, clears the decal z-bias states (0xc3/0xaf) under the same flag tests used by rasterizer_apply_transparent_decal_zbias, and re-invokes rasterizer_set_shader_stage_config when the current decal stage (DAT_006d98dc) equals 3 — the natural counterpart to rasterizer_decal_pass_begin.
results.summary: Cleans up render state after a decal pass, clearing the clip-plane flag and z-bias, and restoring shader-stage configuration for stage 3.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_vertex_build
results.evidence: For each of in_EAX packed 6-byte decal source records (pbVar6, stride 6) computes a world-space position (fVar4/fVar2/fVar3), a packed normal (fVar9) and a packed lighting/color term (fVar7) via a lightmap-index lookup (param_1+0x44/0x48), then writes 4 duplicated vertex entries (stride 0x1e dwords) with a per-corner index offset added to the packed term — building the quad-fan vertices for one decal.
results.summary: Expands packed decal source records into full vertex-buffer entries (position, packed normal, packed lighting) forming the quad geometry for each decal.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_dynamic_vertex_buffer_create
results.evidence: Calls the Direct3D CreateVertexBuffer vtable method (vtable+0x68) with size 0x78000 and dynamic/write-only flags derived from DAT_0069c680/DAT_006e1b1c, storing the resulting handle (or 0 on failure) in DAT_0071d1c8 — the buffer that rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_build subsequently locks and fills.
results.summary: Creates the dynamic Direct3D vertex buffer used to hold static decal vertex data, storing its handle for later locking and drawing.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_set_render_state
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_00689404 and a detail/LOD check (FUN_004c9220 < 2), issues a long fixed sequence of SetRenderState calls (lighting, alpha, fog, texture-stage counts) preparing the fixed-function pipeline for the 'static decal vertices' draw path used by rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_build/draw.
results.summary: Sets up the fixed-function render states used before drawing static (baked) decal vertex geometry.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_build
results.evidence: Guarded by the same feature/LOD gate as rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_set_render_state; locks the dynamic vertex buffer created by rasterizer_decal_dynamic_vertex_buffer_create (vtable+0x2c Lock), then for each decal group/subgroup calls rasterizer_decal_vertex_build to expand packed decal records into the locked buffer, tracking a running write offset and a 0x1000-capped per-batch cache offset, before unlocking (vtable+0x30).
results.summary: Locks the decal dynamic vertex buffer and fills it with expanded quad vertices for each static decal group, tracking buffer offsets across groups.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_draw
results.evidence: For each decal group in param_1, builds per-vertex lighting/plane constant arrays from tag data reached through the group's shader-block index, binds the group's texture via rasterizer_set_texture, uploads them as vertex shader constants (registers 0x13/0x1d), sets the stream source to the buffer built by rasterizer_decal_static_vertices_build, and issues per-subgroup indexed draw calls.
results.summary: Draws the pre-baked static decal vertex batches for each group, uploading per-group lighting/plane constants and issuing per-subgroup indexed draws.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_index_buffer_initialize
results.evidence: Calls the Direct3D CreateIndexBuffer vtable method (vtable+0x6c) with size 0x30000 and format 0x65 (16-bit indices), then for 20 iterations creates per-type geometry sub-caches via FUN_005305f0, sized from a small literal table (0x800, 0x2000, 2, 0x4000, else 0), storing the resulting handles/sizes into the DAT_006d98f0/DAT_006d98ec tables used throughout the dynamic-geometry draw helpers.
results.summary: Creates the shared decal index buffer and allocates per-type geometry sub-caches sized according to a fixed type table.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_index_buffer_dispose
results.evidence: Releases each of the 20 per-type sub-caches allocated by rasterizer_decal_index_buffer_initialize (vtable+8 Release, tracked via DAT_007bf04c/50/54/58) and the shared index buffer DAT_006e09e8 itself, resetting the associated counters DAT_0071d25c/DAT_0071d258 — the natural shutdown counterpart of that initializer.
results.summary: Releases all per-type decal geometry sub-caches and the shared decal index buffer, resetting the associated bookkeeping counters.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_reserve
results.evidence: Reserves in_EDX vertices from a rolling 0x400-slot ring (DAT_006dd9e0/DAT_006dd9e4 arrays) tracked by write cursor DAT_006e09e0 and used-count DAT_006e09e4, returning the allocated slot index, or -1 and setting overflow flag DAT_0071d1cc when the request would exceed either the 0x8000-vertex budget or the 0x400-slot table.
results.summary: Reserves a run of vertices in the dynamic vertex ring buffer, returning the allocated slot index or -1 if the buffer is full.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_reserve
results.evidence: Mirrors rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_reserve's reservation logic but against a per-type capacity table (&DAT_006d98e8 indexed by geometry type in_AX) and a separate 0x400-slot ring (DAT_006d99d8/9dc/9e0), used by the per-type index sub-caches created in rasterizer_decal_index_buffer_initialize, setting overflow flag DAT_0071d1cd on failure.
results.summary: Reserves index-buffer space for a given geometry type from its per-type ring buffer, returning the slot index or -1 on overflow.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_lock
results.evidence: Given a slot index (in_EAX) previously returned by rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_reserve, looks up the corresponding type's index-buffer handle (via DAT_006d98f0/DAT_007bf04c) and calls its Lock vtable method (offset 0x2c) over the reserved byte range, storing the returned pointer into the DAT_006d99e4 table for the caller to write into.
results.summary: Locks the index-buffer region for a previously reserved index-cache slot, returning a writable pointer to it.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_draw
results.evidence: Draws in chunks of up to 10000 vertices/indices per iteration, selecting the stream source/texture per geometry type (param_4); for type 4 it reserves fresh index space via rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_reserve, synthesizes a quad index list, then delegates to rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_draw for the actual submission, otherwise streams directly through vtable+400/0x144.
results.summary: Issues chunked draw calls for dynamic vertex-cache geometry, generating quad indices on the fly for one geometry type before delegating to rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_draw.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_draw
results.evidence: Draws in chunks of up to 10000 indices from a given index-cache slot (param_4), binding the associated per-type index-buffer/texture stream (vtable+0x1a0/0x148), following the same chunking convention as the other dynamic-geometry draw helpers in this module.
results.summary: Issues chunked indexed-draw calls for the geometry stored in a dynamic index-cache slot.

results.name: rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices
results.evidence: Retrieves a vertex declaration from the caller object (unaff_ESI, vtable+0x34), sets it as the current index/vertex declaration (DAT_006e09e8 vtable+0x34), binds the stream source, and issues chunked (<=10000 index) indexed-triangle draw calls; the given (chimera-prefixed) name matches this behavior and is kept with the hint prefix stripped.
results.summary: Draws indexed triangles from a fixed (static) vertex buffer using a vertex declaration supplied by the caller object, chunked to the driver's index limit.

results.name: rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices2
results.evidence: Same chunked indexed-triangle draw pattern as rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices, but additionally binds a second vertex stream (param_3-derived, vtable+400 stream 1) when not on the reduced-detail path (DAT_00722b60==0 && DAT_007c117c>1), indicating a two-stream (extra per-vertex attribute) variant; given (chimera-prefixed) name kept with the prefix stripped.
results.summary: Variant of the static-vertex triangle draw that optionally binds a second vertex stream of extra attributes before issuing the chunked indexed draw.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_draw
results.evidence: Draws in <=10000-vertex chunks from a slot reserved via rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_reserve, selecting the vertex declaration for the geometry via the &DAT_0065e034 type table and binding the per-type index-buffer stream from DAT_006d98f0/DAT_007bf04c — the vertex-cache counterpart of rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_draw.
results.summary: Issues chunked draw calls for geometry held in a dynamic-vertex-cache slot, selecting the vertex declaration for the slot's geometry type.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_geometry_draw_linked
results.evidence: Walks a linked chain of geometry batch records (unaff_EDI/in_EAX), issuing a chunked (<=10000) draw for each and advancing the running vertex/index offset differently depending on the record's type field (0 vs 1), chaining together multiple dynamic/decal batches in one call.
results.summary: Iterates a linked chain of dynamic geometry batches, issuing a chunked draw for each and accumulating the vertex offset according to the batch's type.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_geometry_draw_dispatch
results.evidence: Dispatches to rasterizer_dynamic_index_cache_draw, rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices, rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_cache_draw, or rasterizer_dynamic_geometry_draw_linked based on param_1 (vertex-vs-index geometry source) and param_3 (dynamic-vs-static flag).
results.prototype: void __cdecl rasterizer_dynamic_geometry_draw_dispatch(int source_kind, undefined4 param_2, int is_static)
results.summary: Selects which dynamic/static geometry draw helper to invoke based on the vertex-source and static/dynamic flags.

results.name: rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_single_draw
results.evidence: Binds the stream source for one geometry record (unaff_ESI), applies the per-type texture-stage state, and issues a single non-indexed draw call (vtable+0x154) of the reserved vertex count, returning the index-cache handle it used — a single-batch simplification of rasterizer_dynamic_vertex_draw.
results.summary: Issues a single non-indexed draw call for one dynamic geometry record and returns the index-cache buffer handle used.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_object_append
results.evidence: Appends a transparent-object record (position deltas from the current camera, flags, and object pointer) into a fixed 0x180-capacity list at DAT_0071d14c tracked by count DAT_0071d154, computing the object's signed distance along the camera plane (DAT_007c1234/1238/123c) for later depth sorting, and setting overflow flag DAT_0071d1ce once the list is full.
results.summary: Adds a transparent-object entry, with its camera-relative plane distance and render flags, to the per-frame transparent-object sort list.

results.name: rasterizer_lens_flare_draw
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_00689402 and frustum-visibility flag DAT_007c1220==1; reads a flare-tag struct (in_EAX) with up to 3 flare-element textures/colors, configures additive/screen texture-stage blend states per element, uploads a screen-space quad and modulation constants as vertex shader constants (registers 0xd/0x12), draws each flare element, and for a second style of flare selects an animated shader permutation from &DAT_0069d410 keyed by fade-mode fields.
results.summary: Draws a lens-flare tag's individual flare elements, configuring their blend states and screen-space quad geometry, plus an optional shader-based occlusion/fade variant.

results.name: rasterizer_light_volume_set_texture_stages
results.evidence: Gated by not-first-person (DAT_006893e4==0), feature flag DAT_006893f3, and driver version DAT_007c118c, plus the presence of a light-volume texture DAT_0069d490; configures four texture-stage blend blocks via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture_direct_d3dx (stages 0-3), branching stage 2's blend mode on an underwater/fog flag (DAT_007c110c bit 3), then enables additive/no-fog render states typical of a volumetric light-cone pass.
results.summary: Configures the multi-stage texture and blend states used to draw volumetric light cones/shafts.

results.name: rasterizer_light_volume_compute_shader_constants
results.evidence: Builds an orientation matrix from two animated angles (matrix4x3_from_euler_angles fed by periodic_function_evaluate over the global time DAT_007c1200), transforms it by the light's own basis (matrix4x3_transform_normal, vector3d_cross_product, vector3d_normalize_with_length), then uploads the negated basis/scale as vertex shader constants (registers 0xd and 0x1b) using the light's tag data at &DAT_007c1484 — companion to rasterizer_light_volume_set_texture_stages.
results.summary: Computes and uploads the animated orientation and scale vertex-shader constants for a volumetric light-cone element.

results.name: rasterizer_light_volume_draw
results.evidence: Gated by the same feature flags as rasterizer_light_volume_set_texture_stages; resolves the object's bitmap submap using the same lookup/reload pattern as the rasterizer_set_texture family (FUN_0043f250/FUN_005186c0), sets per-instance transform constants via FUN_00540060, then draws the light-cone geometry for each of param_1's instances by calling rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices.
results.summary: Draws the volumetric light-cone geometry for an object, resolving its texture and per-instance transform constants before issuing the draw calls.

results.name: rasterizer_fog_set_render_states
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_006893f4; sets fixed-function alpha-blend/z-test render states (blend mode toggled by an underwater flag DAT_006893e4==1), configures anisotropic texture-stage filtering when the driver supports it (DAT_00722b68 and render-flag bit 0x20000, LOD>1), then either writes the fog color directly (legacy driver path, DAT_007c118c<0xffff0101) or configures 4 texture stages for a shader-based fog pass on newer drivers.
results.summary: Configures the render and texture-stage states used to draw the screen-space fog overlay, on either the fixed-function or shader path depending on driver capability.

results.name: rasterizer_set_bilinear_texture_stages
results.evidence: Forces bilinear min/mag filtering (texture-stage state 6=2) and mip filtering (state 5=2) plus a neutral mip-LOD-bias constant on texture stages 0-1 (and 2-3 on capable drivers), clears render state 0x89 on legacy drivers, then re-applies rasterizer_set_shader_stage_config.
results.summary: Forces bilinear texture filtering on the active texture stages before re-applying the current shader-stage configuration.

results.name: rasterizer_water_ripple_set_texture_stages
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_0069c6a8 and not-first-person; computes a clip-plane-based fade factor (DAT_006e09f0/DAT_006e09f4, clamped to [0,1]) from the current water plane (DAT_007c1428/142c/1430/1434/144c), and when a ripple-effect tag (DAT_0069e210) is present configures two refraction texture stages via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture_direct_d3dx, branching the exact stage layout on driver shader-model support (DAT_007c118c).
results.summary: Computes the water-surface fade factor from the current clip plane and configures the refraction texture stages for the ripple effect.

results.name: rasterizer_water_ripple_draw
results.evidence: Companion to rasterizer_water_ripple_set_texture_stages: binds the ripple mesh's stream source (declaration table &DAT_006e1a90), selects a vertex-shader permutation via chimera__shader_get_vertex_shader_permutation, uploads distortion constants derived from the water fade factor and DAT_007c1438, then draws each ripple instance via rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices.
results.summary: Draws the water ripple/refraction mesh instances using the vertex declaration and constants prepared for the current ripple effect.

results.name: rasterizer_underwater_overlay_set_render_states
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_006893f1; sets alpha-blend/no-zwrite/no-cull render states, then on legacy drivers configures a clip plane (vtable+0xc4) plus constant fog color/alpha states (0x1c/0x22/0x8b) with two fixed-function multi-texture stages, or on shader-capable drivers configures a different four-stage texture blend layout — preparing the full-screen underwater tint/fog overlay.
results.summary: Configures the render and texture-stage states for drawing the full-screen underwater tint/fog overlay.

results.name: rasterizer_underwater_noise_seed
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_006893f1 and noise-mode DAT_0069c67c>0; when mode==2 fills the underwater color-jitter globals (DAT_006e09f8/9fc/0a00) with a constant (DAT_0068940c); otherwise derives them from a Lehmer/LCG pseudo-random sequence (multiplier 0x19660d) seeded by the input frame value (in_EAX), animating the underwater screen-tint noise consumed by rasterizer_underwater_overlay_set_render_states.
results.summary: Generates a per-frame pseudo-random (or constant) RGB jitter used to animate the underwater screen-tint noise.

results.name: rasterizer_light_halo_draw
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_006893f1; evaluates up to three periodic_function_evaluate flicker channels driven by animation-period fields on param_1 (offsets 0x1b8/0x1f8/0x230) to blend between two keyframe colors/vectors (offsets 0x19c..0x1b0 and 0x1d8..0x1ec), resolves the halo's texture with the same fallback/caching pattern as the rasterizer_set_texture family (FUN_0043f250/FUN_005186c0), and draws the resulting glow quad via rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices2.
results.summary: Draws a light's halo/glow sprite, animating its color and screen-space size via up to three periodic flicker functions before issuing the draw.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_overlay_set_texture_stages
results.evidence: Gated by feature flag DAT_006893fa, not-first-person, and driver version DAT_007c118c; configures a large fixed battery of blend/alpha/fog render and texture-stage states across all 4 stages, matching the structural pattern of the module's other '_set_texture_stages'/'_set_render_states' setup helpers (e.g. rasterizer_light_volume_set_texture_stages) for a shader-based decal/overlay pass.
results.summary: Configures the multi-stage texture/blend/alpha render states for a shader-based decal or screen overlay pass.
